blocks.text:
To: Barbara Blair
Cc: Kelly Snyder, Heather Munoz

Your product descriptions and the priority list came through this morning, and that is what we needed to fix the scope. I have the searches scoped to the features you marked first, and Kelly Snyder has the United States searches running against that scope now. Two of the features are drawn loosely enough that I may come back with a short question before searching them, but nothing there holds up the rest.

We are not reading anything against the results yet. The reference set has to settle first, and Kelly Snyder is keeping it current as the searches turn more up. Once it is stable the claim reading starts, and Heather Munoz will review what it produces before any view on risk for {{fact:f:E-2020-001.client}} reaches you.

So the record stays in one place, everything on the Middleton, Sullivan and Wiley searches is on the docket under this matter, and Kelly Snyder holds that file. If a call on the scope is easier than writing the rest out, send me a couple of times that suit you and I will set one up.
